prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go using package solution.
Required API: func SplitEscaped(x string) ([]string, bool); use (nil,false) for failure
Behavior: Split on unescaped commas. Backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Preserve empty fields. Return the failure value for another escape or a trailing backslash.
Visible example: The input a\,b,,c produces the three fields ["a,b", "", "c"].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func SplitEscaped(x string)([]string,bool){out:=[]string{};cur:=[]byte{};esc:=false;for i:=0;i<len(x);i++{c:=x[i];if esc{if c!=','&&c!='\\'{return nil,false};cur=append(cur,c);esc=false}else if c=='\\'{esc=true}else if c==','{out=append(out,string(cur));cur=nil}else{cur=append(cur,c)}};if esc{return nil,false};out=append(out,string(cur));return out,true}
